name: Cosmo Chemical Co., Ltd.
summary: Cosmo Chemical Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells titanium dioxide anatase in South Korea. The company offers COTIOX KA-100 and COTIOX KA-300, a titanium dioxide anatase type general grade for use in various applications, including white pigments, plastics, rubbers, paints, papers, bricks, TV Braun tubes, MLCC, catalysts, photocatalysts, etc. It also provides ferrous sulfate heptahydrate and monohydrate for use in waste treatment agents, other raw materials, and catalysts; poly ferric sulfate solution, which is used as a waste treatment agent for dyeing, leather, paper, foods, and other wastes; cobalt sulfate liquid for use in lithium 2nd batteries, paint desiccant, pigments, tire bonds, etc.;…
